points.label: Junction of Rocky Lake stream and Paddys–Marsh lake stream
points.identity_evidence: Trace south from Paddys Lake past the minor northern pond branch, then select the lower junction where Rocky Lake stream enters from the east; the outgoing reach runs southwest to the eastern end of Marsh Lake. The separate minor pond junction just north is explicitly excluded. Modern three single-line stream segments 194344, 283498 and 283499 meet at the recorded coordinate; no shoreline node is substituted for a river junction.
points.phase: New measurement after candidate14 freeze, never fit. The surrounding lake network was previously reviewed as identity context; this is correlated with the northwestern interior checks, not an independent region.
points.terrain_context: 10x terrain preview made the basin/network displacement visible. Coordinates are measured from native scan and original NSTDB geometry, not read from the draped view.

points.label: McIntyre Lake western lake–stream junction
points.identity_evidence: McIntyre Lake is north/northeast of the three-armed upper McMillan basin and west/northwest of Buchanan Lake. The western shoreline convergence is visible below the lake label and meets the westward single-stream continuation. Modern lake shores 131784/131786 meet stream 198494 at that coordinate. The whole centroid was withheld because the northern shore is obscured by the Mills label; no hidden boundary was reconstructed. Flow direction is not inferred from the endpoint order.
points.phase: New post-freeze check, not fit. Shares the western mainland region with McMillan control R21; not a distinct whole-panel region.

points.label: Lac LeBlanc outer basin on Isle Madame
points.identity_evidence: Isolated large basin south of the Grand Lake complex, west of the eastern pond and north of the three long lakes behind Arichat Harbour. Distinct northern lobe and southwest neck establish its identity. Full outer shoreline centroid on both sources; internal islands excluded from the outer-ring definition. Historical eastern label overlap and generalized southwest throat remain observation uncertainty. Single stream continuation beyond the southwest closure excluded.
points.phase: New post-freeze physical check; excluded from candidate14 fit, no tuning

points.label: Northern principal Rocky Islets island in Rocky Bay
points.identity_evidence: Northern principal closed island of the Rocky Islets group, offshore northeast of Petit de Grat and southeast of Arichat. Western/northwestern rocks and southern elongated rock/island positions corroborate the group. Only the northern closed island is measured; detached surrounding rocks are not merged into its centroid. Source omits the modern western narrow spur and generalizes the rocky shore.
